description:
This release gathers everything since v0.7.1 and brings 70 patches for Facebook 581.0.0.45.58, up from 60. 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 still work, and phones with a 32-bit processor on Android 11 or newer can patch 581 now too. The ten new ones are `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers`, `Turn off HDR brightness`, `Picture-in-picture`, `Turn off screen transitions`, `Turn off haptics`, `Block Instant Games ads`, `Hide tabs`, `Block screenshot detection`, `Allow screenshots` and `Hold back analytics uploads`. Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer is required.

New in this release

- New patch, `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers`, in the default selection with its switch under Marketplace. A seller's page in Marketplace has Facebook's own View profile button, which opens the seller's regular Facebook profile, but Facebook only gives it to some accounts. Everyone else gets Follow, Message and More, with no way to check who's selling. With the switch on, every seller's page has View profile next to More and in the More sheet too (issue #68).

- New patch, `Turn off HDR brightness`, with its switch under Playback. Facebook turns the screen up for HDR videos and photos in the feed, stories and Reels, which flashes the screen brighter as you scroll past one. With the switch on they play in the screen's usual range at the same resolution, and on Android 15 and newer that covers videos Facebook plays on a surface of their own too. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. Off or paused, Facebook's HDR comes back from the next screen you open (issue #66).

- New patch, `Picture-in-picture`, with its switch under Playback. A reel playing in the Reels tab keeps going in a small window when you go Home or switch apps. A paused reel doesn't open one, and after a swipe the window plays the reel you swiped to. It's the picture-in-picture Facebook already built for its Reels viewer, which it turns on for some accounts, so the window is Facebook's own. It needs Android 12 or later, it's off in Manager's default selection, and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook picture-in-picture patch. Checked on a phone with 581: a playing reel went on playing in the window after Home, a paused one opened no window, the reel a swipe brought up played in it, and with Tap to play on the reel being watched kept playing there.

- New patch, `Turn off screen transitions`, with its switch under Appearance. A tap on a tab or the Menu button shows that page at once instead of sliding to it, and a screen that opens over Facebook, like the post composer, appears and closes without its slide. Swiping between tabs still follows your finger. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook clean-up patch. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on a tab, the Menu and the composer show at once, and with it off each slides in for about a quarter of a second as before.

- New patch, `Turn off haptics`, with its switch under Appearance. Facebook plays a short vibration on many of its own taps and gestures, and with the patch picked and its switch on, those don't play. Your keyboard, your phone's own haptics and a call's ring stay. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook clean-up patch. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on the Menu button opens with no tick, and with it off the tick plays.

- `Hide AI-detected posts` has a new switch, Hide Meta AI in the feed, under News feed. It takes out the Meta AI cards Facebook adds to the feed between posts, by the card's own type, so people's posts stay whatever they say about AI. It starts on.

- `Hide AI-detected posts` also has a Hide AI character posts switch, right below that one. It takes out posts featuring one of Meta's AI characters, the Creator AI and AI Studio characters you can chat with, found by the attachment style Facebook draws a character with. Those are still someone's posts, so the switch starts off.

- Phones with a 32-bit processor on Android 11 or newer can patch Facebook 581.0.0.45.58. Pick its 32-bit build for Android 11 and newer, 475215364 on APKMirror. It keeps its code readable the way the 64-bit build does, and every patch applies to it.

- New patch, `Block Instant Games ads`, in the default selection with its switch under Menu. A game you play in Facebook that asks for an ad, whether a full-screen one, a rewarded one or a banner, is told there's none to show, the answer Facebook gives when it has no ad. So nothing is fetched or played, a rewarded ad gives no reward, and the game carries on. The idea comes from De-Vanced, which drops those asks.

- `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` also covers Marketplace's video ads. The two components that draw one in the feed draw nothing while the switch is on, and the ad's video isn't fetched. The diagnostic report counts them on its Marketplace ads line. The idea comes from De-Vanced's ad patch.

- New patch, `Hide tabs`, with a switch under Appearance for each of the Feeds, Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming and Events tabs. Turn one on and that tab leaves the tab bar once Facebook restarts. Its page stays in the Menu and opens there on a screen of its own, and a start tab set to it opens Home. Checked on a phone with 581, with Friends and Marketplace hidden and then brought back. It's in Manager's default selection with every switch off. The idea comes from Loukious, which hides the Marketplace and Games tabs.

- New patch, `Block screenshot detection`, under Privacy. Facebook watches for screenshots across the app, in the feed, Reels, chats, games, Marketplace and ads, and on Android 14 and newer it can ask Android to report screenshots and screen recordings. With the patch picked and its switch on, it never finds out, so whatever it would do about a screenshot doesn't happen. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on, screenshots taken in the feed and in Reels never reach Facebook's screenshot check, and with it off they do. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from ReVanced's screenshot detection patch, which Loukious and NexAlloy offer too.

- New patch, `Allow screenshots`, under Privacy. Facebook blocks screenshots and screen recordings on a few pages, which come out black. With the patch picked and its switch on, those pages show up in screenshots, recordings and the recent apps view like any other. A page that's already open changes the next time you open it. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from ReVanced's screenshot patch, which Loukious and NexAlloy offer too.

- New patch, `Hold back analytics uploads`, under a new Privacy section. Facebook uploads how you use the app in the background, every three minutes while it's open, and runs Papaya jobs that train models on your phone and report back. With the patch picked and its switch on, the uploads don't start and the Papaya jobs end without running. It's off in Manager's default selection, its switch starts on once it's picked, and a change takes a restart of Facebook.

- With the Saved shortcut switch on, Facebook's Menu gets a Saved row at the end of Settings and privacy, right above Hushfacebook settings. It opens your saved items inside Facebook, and unlike the icon's long-press entry it shows on Samsung phones too. It comes with `Hushfacebook in the Menu`.

- Block account setup reminders, under Notifications, stops the "finish setting up your account" notifications some people keep getting while they're signed in. It starts off like the other notification switches, and login and security alerts still come through (issue #57).

Fixes

- `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` now covers a listing's details page. Its ad rows, "Ads inspired by your views", "Ads from sellers" and "Suggested ad products", come from requests of their own, and those aren't sent anymore. Checked on a phone with 581, the page keeps everything else, from the description and the seller to related items, groups and searches.

- With Save videos other apps can open on, reels and stories that Facebook sends only as AV1 or VP9 picture with xHE-AAC sound now save at their full resolution. Those used to drop to Facebook's own MP4, which for a story can be 360p. The phone now turns the picture into H.264 and the sound into AAC-LC before joining them, which takes a few seconds for a 1080p reel, and the file keeps the colors the original states (issue #77).

- Resume long videos works again for long videos opened full screen. Facebook 581 plays those in its reels viewer, which loops what it plays, so they were skipped as reels. A reel of two minutes or more now resumes like any other long video, and shorter reels still start from the beginning.

- Under Material You, a wallpaper palette with almost no color in its accent no longer turns unseen story rings the same gray as watched ones. Facebook's own blue now stands in for an accent that gray, so unseen rings, unread dots and badges stay easy to tell apart, while the palette still colors the grays. A palette with some color in its accent looks as it did. The diagnostic report's new Material You section gives the accent's chroma (issue #67).

- At large text sizes on narrow screens, the settings home title stays on one line and the empty search field keeps its whole hint visible. Back and Clear search retain their touch targets.

- With `Hide the Reels tab` on, the Reels row in Facebook's Menu opens Reels on a screen of its own. Checked on a phone with 581.

- Messenger and Instagram rows no longer say links open here when Android's link handling is off or the relevant address states are missing. The rows refresh together from one Android answer when you return from settings.

- Hide sponsored reels now stops Facebook's Reels and Watch ad pool from handing an ad out at all. A report from a phone running 0.7.1 with 581 showed the Reels tab's loader drawing an ad from that pool one slot at a time, with the page filter catching it only after the pool had marked it used and logged its position. The pool now answers the way it does when no slot is free, so the loader goes on with the next reel. Facebook isn't serving reel ads to the test accounts here, so this change is built from that report; the diagnostic report counts each ad held back (issues #47 and #35).

Other changes

- Hide the Stories tray no longer waits for Facebook to restart. Turn it on or off and the tray goes or comes back the next time you pull the feed down to refresh. Facebook now builds the tray while it's hidden so it can come back without a restart.

- Hushfacebook now builds on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Manager 1.33.0 carries patcher 1.15.0 and asks for an update before it'll load the bundle.

- Checked on a phone with 581: the reel Download button, its quality choices and the save notification's Cancel all have spoken labels for TalkBack, at normal and double font size. With Check for new Hushfacebook releases on, the daily check runs as Facebook starts.

- Checked on Facebook 577 with every patch: Keep feed position on return holds your place through seven minutes away, and with it off Facebook reloads the feed as it always has. Pull to refresh and a fresh start still load new posts. Pause, the automatic pause after three crashed starts, Marketplace's held ad rows, reel saves with Open and Share, and the diagnostic report all work there too.

- The settings overview shows the version and a short build identity with its source state. About and diagnostic reports retain the full identity. At large text sizes, Pause, Resume and Undo appear before the recovery guidance so they stay in view.

- Installation help explains Expert mode and how to identify overlapping Facebook patch sources. Bug reports now ask for every source's version and patch selection, including the details needed to diagnose issue #79.

Behind the scenes

- Codec cleanup no longer fails a completed media test when closing the launcher's input retries a buffered release byte after the process has exited. Cleanup still reports errors while the launcher is alive.

- The fixture checks run on desktop CLI 1.18.1, which carries patcher 1.15.1. The patcher's new ARSCLib commit is pinned in the dependency verification metadata.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 1.34.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `581.0.0.45.58`. On most phones that's build `475215365`, which APKMirror labels (arm64-v8a) (320-640dpi) (Android 11+). Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `475215364`, labelled (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+). Facebook `580.0.0.51.74`, build `475019344`, and `577.0.0.50.72`, build `474426275`, still work.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 1796 runtime tests and 746 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 70 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 581.0.0.45.58 (both builds), 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check found no advisory for gson 2.14.0, kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 or annotations 13.0.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and record the screen on the pages Facebook blocks them on. Its switch starts on, under Privacy.

patches.name: AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black, or a dark colour you pick, instead of dark grey. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.

options.description: The colour dark mode's backgrounds take, as #RRGGBB. Cards and inputs take a lighter step of it. Leave it blank for black. A colour too light for Facebook's white text is refused.

patches.name: Block ad telemetry
patches.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install for ad attribution.

patches.name: Block background ad prefetch
patches.description: Stops Facebook downloading ads and its ad model in the background. That saves data and battery. The ads don't take up storage either.

patches.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches.description: Keeps your feed position when you return to Facebook within ten minutes, or for any time away with No time limit on. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still work.

patches.name: Block Instant Games ads
patches.description: Games you play in Facebook get no ads. A game that asks for one is told there's none to show, so a rewarded ad gives no reward, and the game carries on.

patches.name: Block promotional notifications
patches.description: Keeps the kinds of notification you pick off your phone, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays. Each kind has its own switch, and they all start off. Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions and login alerts always come through.

patches.name: Block screenshot detection
patches.description: Stops Facebook noticing when you take a screenshot or record the screen, in the feed, Reels, chats, games and everywhere else. Its switch starts on, under Privacy.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides the Follow button on reels and the comment and reaction previews under them. Buttons such as Remix, Use template, Add yours and Stars go too, and each part has its own switch.

patches.name: Default comment order
patches.description: Opens comments in the order you choose in Hushfacebook's settings, Most relevant, Newest or All comments, instead of the one Facebook picks. An order you pick in a post's comments stays for that post, and links to a comment still open on it.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in Hushfacebook's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Facebook picks as it plays. A quality you pick in a video's own menu still wins for that video.

patches.name: Disable Audience Network
patches.description: Stops Facebook serving ads to other apps. Those apps then show their own ads or none, and rewarded ads can fail.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched. It's used to rank your Reels feed, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back in the feed.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, below Facebook's own items. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.

patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Keeps Facebook in dark mode whatever its own setting says, for tablets where Facebook's settings have no Dark mode. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Appearance and restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide affiliate product links
patches.description: Removes the product cards of affiliate shop links from reels, feed posts and the comment sheet. The "Commission eligible" label stays.

patches.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches.description: Removes feed posts that Facebook's own detection marked as made with AI, and the reels and Watch videos it flagged the same way. A third switch also removes posts their creator labelled as AI, a fourth takes out the Meta AI cards Facebook adds between posts, and a fifth removes posts featuring Meta's AI characters. The Meta AI cards switch starts on. The others start off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections of Facebook's Menu. Each has its own switch. Settings, Help and support, your shortcuts and the rest of the Menu stay.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and the Ask Meta AI prompts Facebook adds to search results, and stops search suggestions from opening Meta AI by themselves. People, groups, pages and posts stay, and the Meta AI button still works.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI questions under posts
patches.description: Removes the row of Meta AI questions Facebook adds under some posts. The post, its link card and its buttons stay.

patches.name: Hide post prompts
patches.description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less", who recently commented, or follow and chat suggestions, with no gap left behind. The post stays.

patches.name: Hide posts by words
patches.description: Hides feed posts whose text has a word or phrase you list, unless it also has one from your keep list. Hushfacebook never sends your words anywhere. The switch starts off, so turn it on and add words in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches.name: Hide reel interest prompts
patches.description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt from reels. The reel plays as usual.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of reels between posts in the news feed, and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends. A reel a friend posts stays.

patches.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches.description: Removes the ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results. The feed's request asks Facebook to leave them out and the requests that fetch only ads don't go out. Ads that come back among search results are taken out before Marketplace shows them, and a video ad that reaches the feed anyway isn't drawn. The listings people post stay.

patches.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind.

patches.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches.description: Removes the ads between the posts on someone's profile or a Page. The profile's own posts stay.

patches.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over a reel and ads inside a video.

patches.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, the sponsored posts and ad cards between the people, pages and posts you searched for.

patches.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories only shows stories people posted.

patches.name: Hide Stories tray
patches.description: Adds separate controls for the row of stories at the top of the news feed, Create story included, and the rows of stories Facebook puts between posts.

patches.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads: "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know", suggested groups, "Stories you might like", "Pages you may like" and its own upsells. In-feed surveys go too, and so does the "People you may know" row on your own profile. Each kind has its own switch.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes the stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, the ones marked Suggested in the Stories tray, and the tray's Find friends from contacts card. With Hide suggested and promoted posts in the build too, the tray's People you may know cards go as well. Your friends' stories, the Pages you follow and Create story stay.

patches.name: Hide tabs
patches.description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar: Feeds, Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events. Each page stays in the Menu. Every switch starts off, and a change shows once Facebook restarts.

patches.name: Hide the Feeds header
patches.description: Takes the title row and the All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages filters off the top of the Feeds tab, so it opens on its posts. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under News feed and restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats while Messenger is installed. Facebook only counts a Messenger signed with its own key, so a re-signed Facebook shows the card even with Messenger right there. Without Messenger the card stays.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab, which some accounts call Video, off the tab bar, and its shortcut out of the long-press menu of Facebook's icon. Reel links and the reels in your feed still open. Facebook's own Hide in its tab bar settings keeps working, and a change to the switch shows once Facebook restarts.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab dot
patches.description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, which some accounts call Video. Every other tab keeps its own.

patches.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches.description: Holding a reel plays it at double speed until you let go. The hold takes the place of Facebook's long-press menu, which the reel's more button still opens.

patches.name: Hold back analytics uploads
patches.description: Stops Facebook uploading its app analytics in the background and skips its on-device learning jobs. Its switch starts on, under Privacy. Restart Facebook after changing it.

patches.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy, with a Saved row above it while the Saved shortcut switch is on. The logo long press and the launcher shortcut still open the settings too.

patches.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook. Long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed, or Facebook's launcher icon, to turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install beside the patched Facebook. Facebook shares two permissions with them, and Android lets only one signing key own a permission, so this patch renames Facebook's. A Root Mount install doesn't need it.

patches.name: Keep post dates
patches.description: Keeps the date under the poster's name. Facebook's newer post header can swap that line for rotating details a moment after a post shows, and on some phones the line goes blank. With this on, the line stays put.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: A playback speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels until you pick another or Facebook restarts.

patches.name: Marketplace only
patches.description: Leaves only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu in the tab bar, and opens Facebook on Marketplace. Home with the news feed, Video, Friends, Feeds, Groups, Gaming and Events go. Notifications and links still open where they lead. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Opening Facebook in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Gives Facebook's dark mode the colours of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue palette on Android 11. Light mode stays as it is. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of Facebook's in-app browser, without Facebook's click tracker or the fbclid tag it adds. Facebook pages still open in the app.

patches.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches.description: Lets the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before, and a long press on the icon still does what Facebook does with it. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Chats in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick in Hushfacebook's settings when you start it from its icon. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Notifications and links still open where they lead. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Opening Facebook.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture
patches.description: A reel playing in the Reels tab keeps going in a small window when you leave Facebook, through the picture-in-picture Facebook already has for Reels. Needs Android 12 or later.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Makes profiles and some Settings pages open again on a re-signed build, and lets a Messenger, Messenger Lite or Facebook Lite you patch with this build's own key sign in through it, the same as the real Meta app would. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays, in the feed or full screen. Short reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags, such as mibextid, off the links you share or copy. The post or reel a link opens stays the same. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace it back to you.

patches.name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
patches.description: Every seller's page in Marketplace gets View profile, which opens the seller's regular Facebook profile so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. Its switch starts on, under Marketplace.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Keeps Facebook from crashing or freezing as it starts on an x86 device that runs its arm code through a translator, such as an emulator or an x86 Chromebook, by skipping the one start-up step that breaks there. Phones and tablets with arm chips start as before.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each Story on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn the switch off for Facebook's timing.

patches.name: Stop update prompts
patches.description: Stops Facebook's own update prompts on a patched build, which can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update promotions and the push message that has it look for an update go, and so do chat promotions aimed at older versions.

patches.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Appearance and restart Facebook.

patches.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments. Typing @ still brings up the list. Photo tags and your text aren't touched.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. A tap plays as usual. While its switch is on, Facebook's own Autoplay setting reads Off.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a reel or a video from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. A single tap still plays or pauses, and the Like button still likes.

patches.name: Turn off haptics
patches.description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays on its own taps and gestures. The keyboard and your phone's own haptics stay. Its switch starts on, under Appearance.

patches.name: Turn off HDR brightness
patches.description: Keeps HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness. They play at the same resolution, in the screen's usual range. Its switch starts on, under Playback.

patches.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches.description: Shows Facebook's tabs, its Menu and the screens that open over it at once, without the slide between them. Swiping and animations inside a page stay. Its switch starts on, under Appearance.

patches.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so the ones in posts, comments and chats look like the ones on your keyboard, big chat emoji included. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Restart Facebook after changing the switch.

patches.name: Use the system font
patches.description: Draws Facebook's own text in your phone's font instead of Meta's Optimistic typeface, or in a TrueType or OpenType file you pick in Hushfacebook's settings. Icons and emoji keep their fonts, and so does the text you put on a story. Restart Facebook after changing the font.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you, and stories you've watched keep the ring that marks them as new.

release_notes:

The ten new ones are `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers`, `Turn off HDR brightness`, `Picture-in-picture`, `Turn off screen transitions`, `Turn off haptics`, `Block Instant Games ads`, `Hide tabs`, `Block screenshot detection`, `Allow screenshots` and `Hold back analytics uploads`. Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer is required.

A seller's page in Marketplace has Facebook's own View profile button, which opens the seller's regular Facebook profile, but Facebook only gives it to some accounts. Facebook turns the screen up for HDR videos and photos in the feed, stories and Reels, which flashes the screen brighter as you scroll past one. With the switch on they play in the screen's usual range at the same resolution, and on Android 15 and newer that covers videos Facebook plays on a surface of their own too. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. Off or paused, Facebook's HDR comes back from the next screen you open (issue #66).

- New patch, `Picture-in-picture`, with its switch under Playback. A reel playing in the Reels tab keeps going in a small window when you go Home or switch apps. A paused reel doesn't open one, and after a swipe the window plays the reel you swiped to. It's the picture-in-picture Facebook already built for its Reels viewer, which it turns on for some accounts, so the window is Facebook's own. It needs Android 12 or later, it's off in Manager's default selection, and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook picture-in-picture patch. Checked on a phone with 581: a playing reel went on playing in the window after Home, a paused one opened no window, the reel a swipe brought up played in it, and with Tap to play on the reel being watched kept playing there.

- New patch, `Turn off screen transitions`, with its switch under Appearance. A tap on a tab or the Menu button shows that page at once instead of sliding to it, and a screen that opens over Facebook, like the post composer, appears and closes without its slide. Swiping between tabs still follows your finger. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook clean-up patch. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on a tab, the Menu and the composer show at once, and with it off each slides in for about a quarter of a second as before.

- New patch, `Turn off haptics`, with its switch under Appearance. Facebook plays a short vibration on many of its own taps and gestures, and with the patch picked and its switch on, those don't play. Your keyboard, your phone's own haptics and a call's ring stay. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook clean-up patch. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on the Menu button opens with no tick, and with it off the tick plays.

- `Hide AI-detected posts` has a new switch, Hide Meta AI in the feed, under News feed. It takes out the Meta AI cards Facebook adds to the feed between posts, by the card's own type, so people's posts stay whatever they say about AI. It starts on.

- `Hide AI-detected posts` also has a Hide AI character posts switch, right below that one. It takes out posts featuring one of Meta's AI characters, the Creator AI and AI Studio characters you can chat with, found by the attachment style Facebook draws a character with. Those are still someone's posts, so the switch starts off.

- Phones with a 32-bit processor on Android 11 or newer can patch Facebook 581.0.0.45.58. Pick its 32-bit build for Android 11 and newer, 475215364 on APKMirror. It keeps its code readable the way the 64-bit build does, and every patch applies to it.

- New patch, `Block Instant Games ads`, in the default selection with its switch under Menu. A game you play in Facebook that asks for an ad, whether a full-screen one, a rewarded one or a banner, is told there's none to show, the answer Facebook gives when it has no ad. So nothing is fetched or played, a rewarded ad gives no reward, and the game carries on. The idea comes from De-Vanced, which drops those asks.

- `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` also covers Marketplace's video ads. The two components that draw one in the feed draw nothing while the switch is on, and the ad's video isn't fetched. The diagnostic report counts them on its Marketplace ads line. The idea comes from De-Vanced's ad patch.

- New patch, `Hide tabs`, with a switch under Appearance for each of the Feeds, Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming and Events tabs. Turn one on and that tab leaves the tab bar once Facebook restarts. Its page stays in the Menu and opens there on a screen of its own, and a start tab set to it opens Home. Checked on a phone with 581, with Friends and Marketplace hidden and then brought back. It's in Manager's default selection with every switch off. The idea comes from Loukious, which hides the Marketplace and Games tabs.

- New patch, `Block screenshot detection`, under Privacy. Facebook watches for screenshots across the app, in the feed, Reels, chats, games, Marketplace and ads, and on Android 14 and newer it can ask Android to report screenshots and screen recordings. With the patch picked and its switch on, it never finds out, so whatever it would do about a screenshot doesn't happen. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on, screenshots taken in the feed and in Reels never reach Facebook's screenshot check, and with it off they do. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from ReVanced's screenshot detection patch, which Loukious and NexAlloy offer too.

- New patch, `Allow screenshots`, under Privacy. Facebook blocks screenshots and screen recordings on a few pages, which come out black. With the patch picked and its switch on, those pages show up in screenshots, recordings and the recent apps view like any other. A page that's already open changes the next time you open it. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from ReVanced's screenshot patch, which Loukious and NexAlloy offer too.

- New patch, `Hold back analytics uploads`, under a new Privacy section. Facebook uploads how you use the app in the background, every three minutes while it's open, and runs Papaya jobs that train models on your phone and report back. With the patch picked and its switch on, the uploads don't start and the Papaya jobs end without running. It's off in Manager's default selection, its switch starts on once it's picked, and a change takes a restart of Facebook.

- With the Saved shortcut switch on, Facebook's Menu gets a Saved row at the end of Settings and privacy, right above Hushfacebook settings. It opens your saved items inside Facebook, and unlike the icon's long-press entry it shows on Samsung phones too. It comes with `Hushfacebook in the Menu`.

- Block account setup reminders, under Notifications, stops the "finish setting up your account" notifications some people keep getting while they're signed in. It starts off like the other notification switches, and login and security alerts still come through (issue #57).

Fixes

- `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` now covers a listing's details page. Its ad rows, "Ads inspired by your views", "Ads from sellers" and "Suggested ad products", come from requests of their own, and those aren't sent anymore. Checked on a phone with 581, the page keeps everything else, from the description and the seller to related items, groups and searches.

- With Save videos other apps can open on, reels and stories that Facebook sends only as AV1 or VP9 picture with xHE-AAC sound now save at their full resolution. Those used to drop to Facebook's own MP4, which for a story can be 360p. The phone now turns the picture into H.264 and the sound into AAC-LC before joining them, which takes a few seconds for a 1080p reel, and the file keeps the colors the original states (issue #77).

- Resume long videos works again for long videos opened full screen. Facebook 581 plays those in its reels viewer, which loops what it plays, so they were skipped as reels. A reel of two minutes or more now resumes like any other long video, and shorter reels still start from the beginning.

- Under Material You, a wallpaper palette with almost no color in its accent no longer turns unseen story rings the same gray as watched ones. Facebook's own blue now stands in for an accent that gray, so unseen rings, unread dots and badges stay easy to tell apart, while the palette still colors the grays. A palette with some color in its accent looks as it did. The diagnostic report's new Material You section gives the accent's chroma (issue #67).

- At large text sizes on narrow screens, the settings home title stays on one line and the empty search field keeps its whole hint visible. Back and Clear search retain their touch targets.

- With `Hide the Reels tab` on, the Reels row in Facebook's Menu opens Reels on a screen of its own. Checked on a phone with 581.

- Messenger and Instagram rows no longer say links open here when Android's link handling is off or the relevant address states are missing. The rows refresh together from one Android answer when you return from settings.

- Hide sponsored reels now stops Facebook's Reels and Watch ad pool from handing an ad out at all. A report from a phone running 0.7.1 with 581 showed the Reels tab's loader drawing an ad from that pool one slot at a time, with the page filter catching it only after the pool had marked it used and logged its position. The pool now answers the way it does when no slot is free, so the loader goes on with the next reel. Facebook isn't serving reel ads to the test accounts here, so this change is built from that report; the diagnostic report counts each ad held back (issues #47 and #35).

Other changes

- Hide the Stories tray no longer waits for Facebook to restart. Turn it on or off and the tray goes or comes back the next time you pull the feed down to refresh. Facebook now builds the tray while it's hidden so it can come back without a restart.

- Hushfacebook now builds on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Manager 1.33.0 carries patcher 1.15.0 and asks for an update before it'll load the bundle.

- Checked on a phone with 581: the reel Download button, its quality choices and the save notification's Cancel all have spoken labels for TalkBack, at normal and double font size. With Check for new Hushfacebook releases on, the daily check runs as Facebook starts.

- Checked on Facebook 577 with every patch: Keep feed position on return holds your place through seven minutes away, and with it off Facebook reloads the feed as it always has. Pull to refresh and a fresh start still load new posts. Pause, the automatic pause after three crashed starts, Marketplace's held ad rows, reel saves with Open and Share, and the diagnostic report all work there too.

- The settings overview shows the version and a short build identity with its source state. About and diagnostic reports retain the full identity. At large text sizes, Pause, Resume and Undo appear before the recovery guidance so they stay in view.

- Installation help explains Expert mode and how to identify overlapping Facebook patch sources. Bug reports now ask for every source's version and patch selection, including the details needed to diagnose issue #79.

Behind the scenes

- Codec cleanup no longer fails a completed media test when closing the launcher's input retries a buffered release byte after the process has exited. Cleanup still reports errors while the launcher is alive.

- The fixture checks run on desktop CLI 1.18.1, which carries patcher 1.15.1. The patcher's new ARSCLib commit is pinned in the dependency verification metadata.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 1.34.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `581.0.0.45.58`. On most phones that's build `475215365`, which APKMirror labels (arm64-v8a) (320-640dpi) (Android 11+). Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `475215364`, labelled (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+). Facebook `580.0.0.51.74`, build `475019344`, and `577.0.0.50.72`, build `474426275`, still work.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.
